name: 西安交大西游记
group_note: 神话世界·西游记 version 4.50, in-game branded 《欢乐园》("A Journey to the West"), Xi'an Jiaotong University BBS-affiliated MUD. WASM pass fixed: (1) the familiar convertd.lpc byte-level corruption (45 lines, same 0xce/0xb2/0xee/0x96/0xa3 illegal-character signature at line 250 seen across the sjsh family) -- fixed with the standard byte-level Python script. (2) A genuine syntax error in adm/daemons/logind.lpc's banned_name array literal: a line began with a stray leading comma (',"欢乐园",...' immediately after the previous line's trailing comma), producing an empty array element that isn't valid LPC syntax and cascaded into 5 more spurious parse errors through the rest of the file (including an 'Undefined variable mud_list' further down since the parser never recovered) -- removed the stray comma. (3) §8.1-class is_chinese()/check_legal_name() GBK-byte-pair bugs in adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc and adm/daemons/logind.lpc: both assumed 2-byte-per-character GBK encoding (strlen%2 parity gates, raw byte-range checks against a magic reference string) which reject valid odd-character-count UTF8 Chinese names under this driver's codepoint indexing -- rewrote both to per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff range checks, and fixed check_legal_name's length bound from byte-count (2-12) to character-count (1-6). Also documented (not a bug): a 180-second post-boot connection gate in logind.lpc's encoding() -- CONTROL_CENTER->query('MUD_SRART_TIME') [sic, typo in original source] blocks all logins for 3 minutes after driver start unless the very first line sent is the literal bypass phrase 'let me join ok'; this is intentional anti-flood/startup-settling behavior, not a defect. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (file was completely empty; wiz_levels tops out at (admin), SECURITY_D correctly points at /adm/daemons/securityd, no decoy). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: 'let me join ok' bypass -> English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> single password + confirm (not a dual admin/regular scheme) -> gender (m/f) -> email (optional, blank ok) -> stat-reroll loop (y to accept) -> enters world with a full character sheet, zero unexpected errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via 'wizlist' command output showing '目前权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 7338 .lpc files (7272 written, 3 errors, 63 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. Both map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow (including the 'let me join ok' bypass) -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
